title: Minimal shadowRoots starter
blurb: Canonical 45-line starter passing a custom element's ShadowRoot to document.startViewTransition({ update, shadowRoots }) and verifying capture via document.getAnimations().
question: What is the minimum code required to opt a component's shadow-scoped view-transition-name into a document view transition?
result: Listing [badge.shadowRoot] opts the shadow tree's view-transition-name into capture; browsers without ViewTransitionShadowRoots ignore the member cleanly (not verified in Chrome 160).
testedIn: Chrome 153 / Chromium 157 (flag inactive); not verified in Chrome 160
